description: Loads the cockpit mod, injects the dforge entry point at session start, persists the session's transcript path for budget tooling, appends a compaction snapshot after compaction, runs darkmem's reconcile and pull at session start and pushes at each stop for a repository mapped to darkmem, and holds a stop once when a turn that advanced a plan ends without the finishing menu, the next step or a question its ledger records, once per turn while the budget note says handoff and the turn ends without the next step or a question, or three times in a row when an auto run's turn ends without its sentinel line, then once more after the run stops; after an edit to a UI file it returns UI lint findings and names the ui-ux skill once per session, and it holds a stop once when a turn leaves UI changes without a passing UI proof (both UI checks stand down while the session's latest Process line is fast mode), and it blocks the stop of the Acceptance QA and UI walkthrough seat (impl-sonnet-high) when the report its reply's Report: line names is missing or opens with neither ## Verdict nor # UI proof:.
